name: Egyptian statutory labor-law floors and hour caps (Law No. 14 of 2025)

payload.rationale: Egypt Labor Law No. 14 of 2025 (effective 2025-09-01, Arts. 117-124) caps regular weekly hours at 48h, ordinary daily hours at 8h, and daily workplace presence at 10h (or 12h for Arts. 119/121 intermittent or preparatory work), mandates >= 24h consecutive weekly rest, sets annual leave floors of 15d (year 1), 21d (year 2+), 30d (10+ years or age 50+), and 45d (persons with disabilities/short stature), plus >= 7d supplement for hazardous or remote work.
